global: There is exactly one glossy red billiard ball, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged round rigid shape, glossy red appearance, and intact identity. There is exactly one glossy blue billiard ball, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged round rigid shape, glossy blue appearance, and intact identity.

stages.text: The red billiard ball already has rightward rolling momentum at the first video frame. The blue billiard ball starts motionless. The glossy red billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, rolling right toward the blue ball. For the glossy red billiard ball, this stage changes only horizontal position. The glossy blue billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, motionless to the right of the red ball. A visible green gap separates the two balls and continuously narrows.

The glossy red billiard ball stays continuously visible through the transition as exactly one instance, touching the blue ball at one edge-to-edge contact. For the glossy red billiard ball, this stage changes only rolling speed. The glossy blue billiard ball stays continuously visible through the transition as exactly one instance, touching the red ball at that same contact point. For the glossy blue billiard ball, this stage changes only rolling speed. The single contact occurs before the blue ball begins moving.

The glossy red billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, rolling right more slowly after contact. For the glossy red billiard ball, this stage changes only horizontal position and rolling speed. The glossy blue billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, rolling right ahead after contact. For the glossy blue billiard ball, this stage changes only horizontal position and rolling speed. The blue ball leads while both original balls remain separately visible.

The glossy red billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, rolling right behind at the slower speed. For the glossy red billiard ball, this stage changes only horizontal position. The glossy blue billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, rolling right farther ahead. For the glossy blue billiard ball, this stage changes only horizontal position. A growing green gap opens between the blue ball and the red ball.

The glossy red billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, intact and behind the blue ball. The glossy blue billiard ball is visible as exactly one instance, intact and farther right than the red ball. The final frames keep exactly the two original separated balls visible.
